messages:
maya_cs: Morning async — VerdantAI renewal ping. Quick update:
- What I did: synced with Sales, opened CS-843, validated retry logic, collected sample failed webhook payloads.
- Blockers: we're still seeing ~3% dropped webhooks during the 15:00-16:00 spike window. Need eng logs to finish RCA.
- Today: get trace enabled, reproduce, and draft short RCA for the renewal call. @liam_eng can you take a look at the logs I pasted in the ticket? :pray:

liam_eng: Saw CS-843. Quick Q: do we have consistent request IDs coming from their side? If not, I'll need to enable tenant-scoped request_id capture for better correlation.

maya_cs: We have partial request_id coverage — not consistent. Sample pasted here:
```
[2026-03-15T15:03:12Z] tenant=verdantai event=webhook_fail status=502 req_id= - retry=1
[2026-03-15T15:03:13Z] tenant=verdantai event=webhook_send status=200 req_id=abc123
```

liam_eng: Thanks. I'll enable request_id capture + a temporary tracing flag for VerdantAI and run a short replay. ETA ~2h. @jordan_se can you keep their webhooks paused until tracing is on?

jordan_se: Holding — I paused delivery at 15:45 yesterday per the delivery runbook. I reached out to VerdantAI to confirm a maintenance window 16:30-17:00 today; they tentatively agreed.

anya_success: Context note — renewal call scheduled next Tue. Customer is nervous about reliability. If we can provide a short one-pager with immediate mitigations and timeline, that should calm them. I can draft once we have the RCA bullets.

liam_eng: Proposed approach: enable trace -> replay spike with the replay tool -> probable root cause: upstream proxy timeouts under burst load. If confirmed, mitigation plan includes: (1) temporary rate limiting at edge, (2) retry backoff tuning, (3) autoscaler config tweak for the webhook pool. I'll post test results and timelines to CS-843.

maya_cs: Perfect. Two quick asks: please include a "what we changed" bullet list for the one-pager, and paste the tail command we can give VerdantAI support engineers to tail their tenant logs.

liam_eng: Tail command to share:
```
rg "tenant=verdantai" /var/log/redwood/runtime.log | tail -n 200
```
I'll update CS-843 with findings and the 1-pager draft by 17:00.

deploy-bot: trace flag enabled for tenant=verdantai by liam_eng at 2026-03-15T16:10:00Z :rocket:

maya_cs: Thanks all — I'll hold the renewal prep until your update, @liam_eng. If you need me to call the customer for a short heads-up, say the word. :phone:
